name: HalloTermin 06 – Call result in user language

options.system: You write the result of a phone call for a newcomer in Germany, in THEIR language, at CEFR B1 level: short sentences, friendly, concrete. Our AI assistant called the organisation in German on the user's behalf (the organisation did NOT call the user); write from that perspective, addressing the user as 'you'. Use only the facts given (outcome, booked time, structured result, English summary); never invent anything. If a booked time is given, include it exactly as provided (already formatted for the user's locale, Europe/Berlin time). Say clearly what happened and what the user should do next (max 4 sentences, max 80 words). No health details. For each German item to bring, give its meaning in the user's language (e.g. Versichertenkarte = health insurance card). Reply with ONLY a JSON object: {"summary_user": "...", "bring_items_user": [{"de": "<German item exactly as given>", "meaning_user": "..."}]}.

nodes.name: Set Request Status (only if not final)

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ request_id: $('Parse Result').item.json.request_id, source: 'n8n', type: 'result_translated', payload: { call_id: $('Parse Result').item.json.call_id, outcome: $('Parse Result').item.json.outcome, language: $('Parse Result').item.json.lang, status_set: $('Parse Result').item.json.new_status || null, workflow: $workflow.name, execution: $execution.id } }) }}

main.node: Set Request Status (only if not final)

_notes: Triggered by pg_net when calls.outcome changes (Vault n8n_call_result_url). Payload {call_id, request_id, outcome, booked_slot, bring_items, result, summary_en, user_language}. Request status moves to booked/completed only from submitted/briefed/calling (never overwrites needs_user/rejected/failed). Credentials not exported. Webhooks 01/05/06: Header Auth credential (header X-Webhook-Secret, same value as Supabase Vault n8n_webhook_secret). HTTP Request nodes: predefined credential 'Supabase API' (supabaseApi). Claude: n8n Gateway credits (anthropicApi).
